A '''chando''' was a type of herbivorous, short-necked, [[Dinosaur/Legends|dinosaur]]-like creature that was used as a beast of burden on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Endregaad]]<ref name="Tempest Feud" /> during the era of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]].<ref name="Scourge">[[Scourge (novel)|''Scourge'']]</ref> They were about three [[Meter/Legends|meters]] high and they responded to most stimuli by braying.<ref name="Tempest Feud" /> In [[19 ABY/Legends|19 ABY]],<ref name="Scourge" /> there was an oubreak of a [[Endregaad Plague|deadly viral plague]] on Endregaad, and the [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Simol Toc]] assembled a caravan of chandos to tow some cargo lifters to the [[Temple Valley]] and deliver medicinal supplies to families living in the surrounding region.<ref name="Tempest Feud" />
